snippet.title: A Date With Death 2: Remnants - Official Release Window | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Release Window Trailer for A Date With Death 2: Remnants, a romance visual novel developed by Two and a Half Studios. Players will chart their own path by dating through the Underworld. Train, chat, and flirt in the effort of displaying who you are. A Date With Death 2: Remnants is launching in February 2027 for PC (Steam).
